package drsuapi

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"testing"

	"github.com/oiweiwei/go-msrpc/msrpc/dtyp"
	"github.com/oiweiwei/go-msrpc/ndr"
)

func TestQualificationGenerateContextFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	client := &dtyp.UUID{Data1: 0xe24d201a, Data2: 0x4fd6, Data3: 0x11d1, Data4: []byte{0xa3, 0xda, 0, 0, 0xf8, 0x75, 0xae, 0x0d}}
	ext := make([]byte, 52)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(ext, 0x00080001)
	serverExt := append([]byte(nil), ext...)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(serverExt, 0x00084001)
	handle := &Handle{UUID: &dtyp.GUID{Data1: client.Data1, Data2: client.Data2, Data3: client.Data3, Data4: append([]byte(nil), client.Data4...)}}
	for name, message := range map[string]ndr.Marshaler{
		"drs-bind-request": &BindRequest{ClientDSA: client, Client: &Extensions{Data: ext}},
		"drs-bind-response": &BindResponse{Server: &Extensions{Data: serverExt}, DRS: handle},
		"drs-bind-refusal": &BindResponse{Return: 8453},
		"drs-unbind-request": &UnbindRequest{DRS: handle},
		"drs-unbind-response": &UnbindResponse{},
		"drs-info-request": &GetReplicationInfoRequest{Handle: handle, InVersion: 1, In: &MessageGetReplicationInfoRequest{Value: &MessageGetReplicationInfoRequest_V1{V1: &MessageGetReplicationInfoRequestV1{InfoType: 0, ObjectDN: "DC=example,DC=test"}}}},
		"drs-queue-request": &GetReplicationInfoRequest{Handle: handle, InVersion: 1, In: &MessageGetReplicationInfoRequest{Value: &MessageGetReplicationInfoRequest_V1{V1: &MessageGetReplicationInfoRequestV1{InfoType: 5}}}},
	} {
		wire, err := ndr.Marshal(message)
		if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		t.Logf("fixture %s %s", name, hex.EncodeToString(wire))
	}
}
